fit_method: Censored likelihood: successful RSSI observations + failed-packet count; per-run latent mean RSSI; common Gaussian packet variation and logistic decoder; log-distance regression of calibration-run latent means; between-run residual SD used as persistent link shadowing.
scope_note: Calibrates static two-node DATA RSSI/PDR. Test002 application-ACK timing is retained as validation evidence but is not asserted to equal native simulator MAC timing.
